# pve_storage_pbs (Data Source)

Reads a Proxmox Backup Server storage definition from `GET /storage/{storage}` (type `pbs`). The computed `fingerprint` and `master_pubkey` attributes carry the PBS identity material returned by the storage configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

data "pve_storage_pbs" "pbs1" {
  storage = "pbs1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `storage` (String) The storage identifier to look up.

### Read-Only

- `content` (Set of String) Allowed content types (PVE `pve-storage-content-list`), for `pbs` typically only `backup`.
- `datastore` (String) The Proxmox Backup Server datastore name.
- `digest` (String) The read-only storage configuration revision (PVE `digest`).
- `disable` (Boolean) Whether the storage is disabled.
- `fingerprint` (String) The server certificate SHA 256 fingerprint — part of the PBS identity of this storage.
- `master_pubkey` (String) Base64-encoded, PEM-formatted public RSA master key (PVE `master-pubkey`) — part of the PBS identity of this storage.
- `max_protected_backups` (Number) Maximal number of protected backups per guest (PVE `max-protected-backups`).
- `namespace` (String) The Proxmox Backup Server namespace.
- `nodes` (String) Comma-separated list of cluster node names the storage applies to.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The user password or API token secret used to authenticate.
- `port` (Number) Optional port used to connect to the server.
- `prune_backups` (String) The retention options in PVE `prune-backups` format.
- `server` (String) The Proxmox Backup Server address.
- `skip_cert_verification` (Boolean) Whether TLS certificate verification is disabled.
- `type` (String) The storage type, always `pbs` for this data source.
- `username` (String) The user name or API token ID used to authenticate.
